meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为 agent 规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为 agent 核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 OpenAI 的 Codex 作为完整的智能体后端，负责规划、调用工具、管理对话历史和会话恢复。你可以选择用 Codex 代替 Claude，或者两者并用。
howto.when: 当你通过 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 命令为某个群组切换提供者为 Codex，并重启该群组后触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Codex 规划一个项目，包括工具调用和会话历史。
say.note: Codex 会接管规划与工具编排。

say.text: 切换到 Codex 提供者，并恢复上次的对话。
say.note: Codex 支持服务端历史记录和会话恢复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use OpenAI's Codex as a full agent backend for planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume. You can use Codex alongside or instead of Claude.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you switch a group's provider to Codex via `ncl groups config update --provider codex` and restart the group.

say_en.text: Help me plan a project with Codex, including tool calls and conversation history.
say_en.note: Codex will handle planning and tool orchestration.

say_en.text: Switch to Codex provider and resume the last conversation.
say_en.note: Codex supports server-side history and session resume.
